text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, with Bamboo Memory's debut race just around the corner…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Let's get started!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey! Hey, Yaeno! Fancy seeing you here!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (Yaeno Muteki is in the same year as me, and she studies martial arts. She's really cool and approaches her training with great discipline day in and day out!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hello, Bamboo.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Are you also here to train?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yep! My debut race's coming up, so I've gotta put the pedal to the metal!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I usually come here to train or practice my sword swings in order to clear my mind. Is that what you're doing?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: In a way. I am also here in an attempt to quiet my heart.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I knew it! Well, since we're both here for the same reason, let's both give our 110 percent!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'd like that.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hmph! Hah! Hmph! Hah! 100 more to go!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hah! Hmph! Raaah!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Phew! I worked up a good sweat!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Your swings were so clean yet full of passion. I can feel how eager you are for your debut in how you wield the blade.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I could say the same about you! Watching you made me want to work even harder at perfecting my swings!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I've been thinking this for a while, but we're pretty similar, huh?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You said before that you're going to take on races against strong opponents, right?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That's correct. I desire to compete in races where I can pit the full fury of the fiery blaze within me against formidable opponents. That is what I seek upon the turf.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Me too! My dream is to find the ultimate rivals to face off against in the ultimate race!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: See, doesn't that makes us pretty similar?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I suppose so. Both of us yearn to partake in battles where we must contend with mighty opponents.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yeah, exactly!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: However, I don't believe we seek the same things from our battles against our foes.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hm… What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: If I am to triumph over my adversaries using the heart, technique, and strength of a martial artist, I must raise those qualities to even greater heights than my opponents have.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And while challenging these adversaries, I hope to grow and learn from them in the midst of battle. But above all…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: This is the path by which I hope to repay the debt I owe my grandparents, who tamed my violent and erratic nature by teaching me the Kongo Yaegaki style.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Only by honing both my mind and body through fighting such formidable foes will I be able to repay the kindness my grandparents showed me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That is what awaits me at the end of my battles. Or, to borrow your own words…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That is my dream.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And if I may be so bold as to reveal another of my goals, I wish to one day score but a single point against my grandfather in a match…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: But I digress… Um, Bamboo? Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That's…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That's an amazing dream!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Your passion made my heart skip a beat! You're so cool! I'm moved!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Your grandfather's your teacher and your rival! That's the awesomest thing ever!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I've never thought of Grandp—I mean Grandfather—as my rival before. It's certainly a refreshing point of view, though.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: In any case, you give me far too much credit. My trifling dream is not worthy of such praise.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Nuh-uh, it totally is! Your dream's the best, Yaeno! I'm gonna do everything I can to cheer you on! And you know what?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I promise to get so strong that, when we end up racing each other one day, you'll consider me one of your formidable opponents!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Then, I'll also work hard so I can become one of the ultimate rivals you seek.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That way, we can both help each other grow.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Whoa, you really mean it?! WOOOO! I'm so excited! It's a promise, then! No take backs!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Of course not. It's a promise.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: …And that's what happened! What she said really shook me to my core, but in a really, really good way!
choice_data_list: Sounds like your list of potential rivals just got longer.
Sounds like your list of potential rivals just got longer.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: It sure did!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: All right! I'm ready to give training 110 percent today and set the track on fire!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory's debut race is just around the corner, and the flames of her fighting spirit are leaping higher than ever!
